description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectAccountButton, which extends SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectButton. The class provides a display method that includes access control logic to determine if the button should be rendered, specifically checking user permissions related to editing Accounts and Membership Organizations within the SuiteCRM application.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectAccountButton
classes.description: A widget class responsible for displaying a select button in subpanels for Accounts, with access control considerations.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the button for selecting an account if the user has appropriate permissions; otherwise, it returns without rendering.
